name: Ammarnäs-Aigert
description: Ammarnäs to Aigert. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Lilla Aigertstugan safety room / dog room (shelter)
STF Aigert Fjällstuga / Aigert Mountain Cabin (lodging)
Vindelfjällen reserve information board on Aigert ascent (service)
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF, Naturkartan and Vindelfjällen all report 8 km, but WFS/Naturkartan GPX ledstart-to-Aigert geometry measures about 6.1-6.4 km. OSM clips from naturum/village give about 7.46 km and full relation with Näsberget/Liftvägen connector gives about 8.69 km.
STF gives 2-3 hours; Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen gives 3-4 hours.

STF says the stage starts in Ammarnäs village at the bridge over Vindelälven. Naturkartan says start from naturum, cross Tjulån, follow signs to Entré Kungsleden parking, or drive to the parking. Official line geometry starts at the ledstart/parking.
STF stage short label is Aigert, while Naturkartan/Vindelfjällen and facility sources use Aigertstugan / STF Aigert Fjällstuga.
OSM maps an emergency=phone node at Aigert, but STF/Naturkartan state there is no help phone and official Anordningar has no Aigert help-phone record.
TimeOfTiger reported the sauna closed during COVID in 2021, but current STF/Naturkartan and 2014 field photo evidence support sauna availability.
Naturkartan confirms Aigertstugan toilet but does not expose a page-text coordinate; coordinate in this pass comes from OSM way 1205576564.
